verdict.rationale: Empresa Online is a government online-incorporation service. A service of this kind could plausibly expose versioned APIs with a deprecation policy, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents only the web flow (authentication, pact signing, payment, notifications) and contains no mention of any API, versioning scheme, or deprecation policy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
